name: flight
description: Files over light — airgapped file transfer over animated QR codes, screen to camera, no network.

scripts.vectors: node --import tsx tests/extract_vectors.mjs > tests/vectors.json && node tests/dump_qr.mjs > tests/qr-vectors.json
scripts.test:parity: npm run vectors && python3 tests/test_parity.py && python3 tests/test_qr.py
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:parity && npm run test:loopback && npm run test:decode
